name: io.github.yanglinfeng/memory-bridge
description: Local-first knowledge and memory layer for MCP. Every answer carries source citations and a replayable traceId; bi-temporal document versioning keeps revoked docs out of default recall; user/namespace/scope isolation and a full audit log. Runs entirely on your machine with SQLite and local Ollama — no cloud, no API keys.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_BRIDGE_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the directory holding the SQLite database and derived indexes. Defaults to ./data under the current working directory.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_BRIDGE_OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the local Ollama runtime used for generation and embeddings. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:11434.
